title: Constant finite coefficients on the projective line from a cyclic generator
statement: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field, let $n$ be invertible in $k$, and put $P=\mathbf P^1_k$ as in [lem-asd-projective-line-genus-zero]. Let $\theta\in H^2(P,\mathbf Z/n)$ generate this abelian group. For every finite abelian group $A$ killed by $n$, the map $\operatorname{Hom}(\mathbf Z/n,A)\to H^2(P,A)$ sending $\phi$ to $\phi_*(\theta)$ is bijective.

source.place: Geometric-fibre calculation and finite coefficient extension

proof.text: For m dividing n, the reduction Z/n -> Z/m induces a surjection on H^2: the kernel is torsion and H^3 of a torsion sheaf on a curve vanishes. Hence the image of theta generates H^2(P^1,Z/m). Proper-curve cohomology identifies that group with Z/m. Thus evaluation on theta is bijective on each cyclic coefficient. Apply additivity and the structure theorem for finite abelian groups to extend this natural bijection to A.

proof_origin.place: Cyclic devissage replaces derived coefficient extension

theorem projectiveLine_constant_coefficient_generator
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] (n : ℕ) (hn : (n : k) ≠ 0)
    (θ : Sheaf.H ((ProjectiveLine (Spec (.of k))).constantZMod n) 2)
    (hθ : ∀ y, ∃ c : ℕ, y = c • θ)
    (A : AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) [Finite A] (hA : ∀ a : A, n • a = 0) :
    Function.Bijective ((sheafHConstantSheafNatTrans
      (ProjectiveLine (Spec (.of k))) n 2 θ).app A)
